name: Linkle Companion
description:
Adds Linkle, a dual-crossbow follower companion with her own personality. Craft a Wanderer's Compass to summon her.

Unofficial fan project. Linkle is a character from Hyrule Warriors, owned by Nintendo and Koei Tecmo. Not affiliated with or endorsed by them.
